title: Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Demonstrations are an effective way to accelerate single-agent reinforcement learning (RL), but extending this idea to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is non-trivial as it is difficult and often impossible for a single person to teleoperate multiple agents simultaneously. Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC) addresses this by letting a single demonstrator control one agent at a time while the others execute their current policies. However, the resulting imitation policies are limited by the quality of the demonstrations. We propose Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (IBMARL), a framework that extends Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning (IBRL) to cooperative teams and uses R2BC to train the imitation policies. translated_title: 模仿引导的多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 演示是加速单智能体强化学习（RL）的有效方法，但将这一思想扩展到多智能体强化学习（MARL）并非易事，因为让单个人同时远程操控多个智能体十分困难，且往往无法实现。轮替行为克隆通过让单个演示者每次只控制一个智能体、而其他智能体执行其当前策略的方式解决了这一问题。然而，由此得到的模仿策略受到演示质量的限制。我们提出了模仿引导多智能体强化学习（IBMARL），这是一个将模仿引导强化学习（IBRL）扩展到协作团队、并使用R2BC来训练模仿策略的框架。在每个时间步，每个智能体分别从其模仿策略和RL策略各获得一个动作提议，然后由一组集中式评论家集成在每个智能体的组合中进行选择……
tldr: 该论文提出IBMARL框架，将模仿引导强化学习扩展到多智能体协作场景，通过轮替行为克隆训练模仿策略，并利用集中式评论家集成在模仿策略与RL策略的动作提议中进行选择，从而克服了单演示者难以同时操控多个智能体以及演示质量有限的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes IBMARL, a framework that extends imitation bootstrapped reinforcement learning to cooperative multi-agent teams by using Round-Robin Behavior Cloning to train imitation policies and leveraging an ensemble of centralized critics to select between imitation and RL action proposals, overcoming the difficulty of single-demonstrator teleoperation and limited demonstration quality.
